process.detail: We map users, business goals, existing systems, constraints, and what success means.
We reduce uncertainty into a scope, technical approach, milestones, and trade-offs.
We deliver in reviewable increments, test critical behaviour, and keep decisions visible.
We deploy, document, measure the result, and prioritise what should improve next.

faqs.question: What does a project cost?
faqs.answer: Work ranges from about KES 10,000 for a single advisory session to over KES 1.5M for a full platform or multi-phase programme. The figure depends on scope, integrations, and how much is already defined. We give a written quote after a short discovery call.

faqs.question: Why such a wide price range?
faqs.answer: A brochure website and a multi-role platform with payments and offline support are different pieces of work. Price follows scope, number of integrations, compliance needs, and how much discovery is still required.

faqs.question: How do payments work?
faqs.answer: Projects are milestone-based: a deposit to start, then payments tied to agreed deliverables. Advisory sessions are paid upfront. Monthly partnerships are invoiced monthly.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: A focused website takes 3 to 8 weeks, an application MVP 8 to 16 weeks, and larger platforms run longer and are split into phases. Discovery normally takes 1 to 3 weeks.

faqs.question: Who owns the code?
faqs.answer: You do, once the work is paid for. We keep rights to our pre-existing tools and general know-how. Ownership is set out in the engagement agreement.

faqs.question: Do you offer support after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Documentation and handover are part of delivery, and ongoing support is available as a monthly partnership from about KES 35,000 per month.

faqs.question: What technologies do you use?
faqs.answer: Commonly Next.js and React on the web, cross-platform frameworks for mobile, Python and Node for services and AI, and mainstream cloud providers. We choose the smallest dependable system for the job rather than a fixed stack.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing team or codebase?
faqs.answer: Yes. We do technical audits, join existing teams, and take over legacy systems. That usually starts with a due diligence engagement.

faqs.question: Do you work with small budgets?
faqs.answer: Yes. If the budget will not cover the full idea, we say so and propose the smallest useful first version, or advise against building where a simpler tool would do.

faqs.question: Where are you based and who will I work with?
faqs.answer: Every engagement is staffed with senior people who have delivered systems in production. The people who scope your work are the people who build it.
